text: Brent closed at 92.94 USD/bbl on 17 November, essentially flat against the previous close of 92.90 USD/bbl and up 3.1% over the week, though still down 22.1% over the month. In Egypt, the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 December on 1 November, and on 28 September Genel Energy agreed to buy Capricorn Energy's Western Desert interests for USD 436 mn.
